{{Top|leg}}
The '''Rylith crystal''' was a [[Crystal/Legends|crystal]] capable of collecting and storing solar energy. This characteristic made the [[Rylith power cell]] a popular choice as a component in the design of advanced weapon power supplies.

The crystals were found on the surface of the planet [[Demophon]] during the time of the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]]<ref name="SN">[[Supernova (sourcebook)|''Supernova'']]</ref>.
